answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1461 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the sparrow. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the onyx queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The island index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 161 pays that 179 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
